_comment: Compatibility ligatures that PDF text extraction keeps from typeset
manuscripts (e.g. 'Eﬀectiveness') and that the bundled report fonts do
not draw. When no bundled face covers one, the export draws its Unicode
compatibility (NFKC) letters instead ('ff'). Display only: the saved
evidence text is unchanged. Listed explicitly because NFKC is not safe in
general (it would draw a superscript 2 as a plain 2).
